name: Active Entity Glow Breathing Pulse
visual_intent: Draws viewer visual focus to a specific server, leader node, or memory cell during state transition.

parameters.name: targetSelector
parameters.description: CSS selector for node or card to glow (e.g. '#leader-node').

parameters.name: glowColor
parameters.description: Hex or rgba color for glow luminescence.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Timestamp in seconds to begin glow pulse.

timeline_requirements.timing_anchors: Anchored to leader election, quorum consensus, or state transition trigger.

fallbacks: Stroke width and color flash if box-shadow or SVG filter is constrained.
validation_steps: Snapshot at startTime + (pulseDuration / 4) to verify peak luminous radius.
Verify no frame drops or GPU memory leaks on repeated pulses.
